summary: Sieve is a language for filtering email on the server. This extension adds an include command so one Sieve script can pull in another, which makes large scripts easier to manage. Users can include their own scripts or site-wide ones and build libraries of reusable rules.

eli5.summary: Instead of writing the same mail sorting rules again and again, you keep them in separate cards and tell your script to also read this card.

questions: how to include one sieve script in another
what is the sieve include extension
